Guideline 003-15 on the Procedure to Apply for and Extend Foreign Work Permit and Foreign Employment Card
Cambodia National Trade Repository (Ministry of Economy and Finance)
Measure: Fee requirement to Apply for and Extend Foreign Work Permit and Foreign Employment Card

facts.c: MLVT Guideline 003-15 sets the procedure to apply for and extend the foreign work permit and foreign employment card.
facts.q: Procedure to apply for and extend foreign work permit and foreign employment card are stipulated in this guideline

facts.c: The fees to apply for and extend the foreign work permit and foreign employment card are set in Guideline 003-15, in force from 26 January 2015.
facts.q: Fee to apply for and extend foreign work permit and foreign employment card are stipulated in the guideline
facts.note: The repository lists the guideline as valid from 26/01/2015 but does not give the amounts; the guideline text itself was not found.
